{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Define mask for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
completed_mask = sales['status'] == 'completed'
not_internal_test_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99

# Apply both masks
valid_orders = sales[completed_mask & not_internal_test_mask]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = valid_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print result
total_revenue"}
